description: Search Spotify by name and immediately play the best match. Works for songs and podcast episodes — no URI needed.

device_id.description: Target device ID; uses active device if omitted

dry_run.description: Preview only: describe what would change without performing it. Default false — pass true to preview.

market.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code — affects availability/relinking of results; defaults to SPOTIFY_MCP_MARKET

query.description: Search text, e.g. a song title or podcast episode name

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

search_type.description: What to search for: 'track' (song) or 'episode' (podcast episode)

name: play_from_search
